Date: 02/06/2026

## GOHREP
**Goal:**

Interactively view CDA bounding box annotations overlaid on raw agroinfiltration
images, to check and verify collected annotations.

**Hypothesis:**

Annotation mistakes will be present and need to be identified visually.

**Experimental plan:**

Run in 'cda' mode to step through one CDA at a time, or 'raw' mode to see all
CDAs for a full agroinfiltration image at once. Press spacebar to save the current
view as a JPEG. Requires connection to the lab network drive.

Corrections to coordinate placements were recorded manually in
combined_cda_data_checked_1.csv and combined_cda_data_checked_2.csv.

### 1. Import required packages
Note: The Tkinter window closes when you close the interactive session — this is expected.
```{python}
# 1
from pathlib import Path

repo_root = next(p for p in [Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents] if (p / '.git').exists())
from annotation_viewer import view_annotations
```

### 2. View Set 1 — one CDA at a time
```{python}
# 2
view_annotations(
    data_path=repo_root / "analyses/01_generate_raw_data/02_combining_cdascorer_outputs/combined_cda_data_1.csv",
    raw_folder_path="/Volumes/shared/Research-Groups/Mark-Banfield/Josh_Williams/Scoring_5May",
    mode='cda',
    starting_row=0,
)
```

### 3. View Set 2 — one full image at a time
```{python}
# 3
view_annotations(
    data_path=repo_root / "analyses/01_generate_raw_data/02_combining_cdascorer_outputs/combined_cda_data_2.csv",
    raw_folder_path="/Volumes/shared/Research-Groups/Mark-Banfield/Josh_Williams/Scoring_20Oct",
    mode='raw',
    starting_row=0,
)
```
